The successor changes which artifact owns Plan meaning and must preserve the owner decision and authority ceiling.
Blocked prerequisites and failed validation must stop before implementation authority is inferred.
The Design must close every applicable machine-backed readiness and execution consumer while recording Signal Observer as a conditional machine-contract gap.
The successor must replace Work-Pack-as-source wording without rewriting historical artifacts or hiding the compatibility boundary.
No runtime latency or throughput claim is made; deterministic correctness is the required quality property.
The compiler and admission steps create exact absent outputs and must define writer ownership and collision behavior.
The bounded source contains repository planning evidence and introduces no personal-data collection or retention sink.
The source-to-view chain must replay deterministically and expose stale or incomplete consumer evidence.
This Design authors local governed artifacts and performs no runtime activation, publication, deployment, or release.
No authentication, authorization transport, credential, or security boundary is introduced by this local authoring contract.
Plan tasks, waves, gates, blockers, and terminal handoff states require explicit transition rules.
The generated WORK-PACK.md changes how a plan coordinator finds tasks, waves, gates, blockers, and the next eligible action, so its readable navigation contract requires design and validation.
Every source, generated view, predecessor binding, and downstream readiness claim requires machine validation.

facts.name: W1 acceptance and readiness claims: claim:w1-input-closure

attributes.old_contract: stored WORK-PACK.md is described as the Plan source of truth
attributes.new_contract: stored canonical JSON Plan source owns meaning and WORK-PACK.md is generated

attributes.responsibility: Exclusively project WPRA, Implementation Readiness, Task Session, Context Builder, Dispatch, Goal, and observer handoff contracts from the normalized graph according to the exact consumer applicability matrix.
Independently recompile, byte-compare, and rehearse every applicable machine-backed consumer without product effects.
Publish one complete Plan candidate bundle through an absent staging directory and atomic replacement.

Act as a conditional post-admission boundary adapter that reads external lifecycle receipts and keeps authored, admitted, readiness, acceptance, execution, and terminal outcomes on separate axes; it is not a mandatory authoring stage.
Compile the exact Plan source into one normalized graph shared by every projection.

Act as a conditional compatibility adapter when historical Work-Pack-as-source material is supplied; it validates that material without admitting it for a new Plan PASS and is not a mandatory authoring stage.
Validate the canonical Plan source and its graph invariants before any view is generated.
Render only Work Pack, task, wave, layering, and optional Execution Pack human navigation from the normalized graph; this component emits no consumer contract.

attributes.statement: Every possible consumer has a machine-checkable applicability predicate; applicable consumers require exact no-effect rehearsal and inapplicable consumers require negative evidence.
attributes.failure_boundary: Missing predicates, skipped consumers, or prose-only closure claims block admission.

attributes.statement: Each possible consumer has explicit predicate inputs, true and false results, required negative evidence, produced projection, no-effect validator or rehearsal, and failure route.
attributes.versioning: New successor contract bound to the Plan source schema.
attributes.failure_boundary: An absent, ambiguous, or unevaluable consumer row blocks bundle admission.

attributes.statement: Use 1.2.0 when no transient outputs are declared and 1.3.0 when the transient-output set is nonempty.
attributes.versioning: Deterministically selects one currently supported contract.
attributes.failure_boundary: A version inconsistent with the exact transient-output set blocks the projection.

attributes.statement: Admission replays the exact source, compares every output byte, and validates every applicable consumer without granting readiness or execution.
attributes.versioning: New successor contract; historical receipts are validate-only.
attributes.failure_boundary: Any stale binding, byte mismatch, missing consumer proof, or unknown value blocks admission.

attributes.statement: One JSON source owns objectives, slices, layers, waves, tasks, SWUs, implementation details, validation obligations, gates, blockers, gaps, eligible execution entries, and closeout obligations.
attributes.versioning: Successor v2; historical v1 material remains validate-only.
attributes.failure_boundary: Reject invalid or ambiguous graphs before generating views.

attributes.statement: A plan coordinator can locate objectives, slices, waves, tasks, gates, blockers, gaps, and the next eligible action without treating the view as semantic authority.
attributes.versioning: Generated from the exact Plan source; manual edits are drift.
attributes.failure_boundary: Unreadable, incomplete, or source-divergent navigation blocks bundle admission.

attributes.question: Is any unit delegated or executable from bounded context?
attributes.decision: Read unit.delegated and unit.bounded_context_execution. True produces a strict native-context projection and runs compile_native_context_projection.py with version derived from transients; false requires every unit flag false; mismatch or failed validation blocks admission.
attributes.rationale: Context packs are required only where a bounded execution or delegation boundary exists.

outcomes.result: Project and validate strict native context.
Record unit-level negative evidence and omit the context projection.

attributes.question: Does the Plan require a full dispatch graph?
attributes.decision: Always emit a technique trace. Read route.multi_owner, delegated, protected_scope, and reusable_graph. Any true value produces a schema-valid dispatch and runs validate-dispatch.py in no-effect rehearsal; all false values retain trace-only negative evidence; unknown or failed validation blocks admission.
attributes.rationale: Simple single-owner work does not need a full dispatch graph, but delegation technique evidence is never omitted.

outcomes.result: Project and rehearse the full dispatch graph.
Keep technique trace and record negative evidence for the full graph.

attributes.question: May the Plan source record achieved lifecycle outcomes?
attributes.decision: No. Admission, readiness, selection, acceptance, execution, terminal, and continuity outcomes remain external receipts.
attributes.rationale: Authored intent cannot manufacture evidence about later work.

attributes.question: Does the Plan expose a Goal-compatible route?
attributes.decision: Read routes[].capability. A goal route produces frontier, route, expected receipt, stop, and fallback policy and runs Goal validation without ledger mutation; no goal route requires exact route-negative evidence; unknown or failed validation blocks admission.
attributes.rationale: Goal projection is route-specific and cannot be inferred from generic tasks.

outcomes.result: Project and validate the Goal route without mutation.
Record route-negative evidence and omit the Goal projection.

attributes.question: Can this Plan nominate an implementation unit?
attributes.decision: Read mutation_capable and execution_entries. A mutation-capable Plan with an eligible entry produces arcanum.work-pack-execution-entry/v1 and runs validate_work_pack_execution_entry.py; otherwise exact empty-entry or mutation-false evidence is required; unknown or failed validation blocks admission.
attributes.rationale: Artifact admission must not manufacture implementation readiness.

outcomes.result: Project and validate the readiness entry.
Record negative evidence and omit the readiness projection.

attributes.question: Is observability configured and is a machine observer contract admitted?
attributes.decision: Read observability.configured and observer_contract_admitted. Both true are required before producing and no-append validating an observer envelope. Configured without an admitted contract blocks observer closure and defers observability-configured execution; configured=false records negative evidence and emits no projection.
attributes.rationale: Observer prose alone cannot become machine admission evidence.

outcomes.result: Project and validate the no-append observer envelope.
Record configuration-negative evidence and omit the observer projection.
Preserve the observer gap and block an observer-closure claim.

attributes.question: Does Signal Observer prose establish consumer closure?
attributes.decision: No. Preserve a conditional gap until a schema, deterministic projector or validator, and no-append fixture exist.
attributes.rationale: README and skill prose cannot be machine-admitted evidence.

outcomes.condition: Observability is configured without machine contracts.
outcomes.result: Flag the gap and block an observer-closure claim.

attributes.question: Which artifact owns Plan meaning?
attributes.decision: One canonical JSON Plan source owns meaning; Markdown and execution documents are generated views.
attributes.rationale: A single machine source prevents contradictory edits and supports deterministic replay.

attributes.question: Does an execution entry route to Task Session?
attributes.decision: Read every execution_entry.route. Any task-session route produces an eligible-unit contract only and rehearses Task Session admission validation without selecting or launching work; otherwise all routes must prove they are not task-session; missing or failed evidence blocks admission.
attributes.rationale: Plan authorship may expose eligibility but cannot grant live Task Session admission.

outcomes.result: Project the eligible-unit contract and validate it without effects.
Record route-negative evidence and omit the Task Session projection.

attributes.question: Is the Plan mutation-capable?
attributes.decision: Read source field mutation_capable. True produces audit config v2, semantic manifest, and selection handoff and rehearses audit_work_pack.py; false requires exact mutation_capable=false evidence and produces no WPRA projection; missing or failed evidence blocks admission.
attributes.rationale: WPRA is required only for Plans that can reach mutation.

outcomes.result: Record negative applicability evidence and omit WPRA projection.

attributes.failure_policy: Require Task Session and strict Context Builder projections only when their route predicates are true.
Block admission when required WPRA or Implementation Readiness projections fail.

facts.name: Derived view becomes a second source

attributes.risk: A generated Markdown or execution view is edited as if it owned Plan meaning.
attributes.mitigation: Bind every view to the source digest and reject byte drift during admission.

attributes.risk: Signal Observer is counted as admitted without a machine contract or no-append rehearsal.
attributes.mitigation: Keep the integration flagged and prohibit a closure claim until machine evidence exists.

facts.name: Historical Plan format establishes new PASS

attributes.risk: A v1 Work-Pack-as-source artifact is treated as current successor evidence.
attributes.mitigation: Validate historical formats read-only and require the successor source and admission for every new PASS.

attributes.subject: Plan admission
attributes.object: every applicable machine-contract-backed readiness and execution consumer
attributes.enforcement_hint: Run the exact consumer contracts against the staged bundle before PASS; report consumers without machine contracts as gaps.

attributes.subject: native-context admission projection
attributes.object: 1.2.0 when transient outputs are absent and 1.3.0 when the declared transient-output set is nonempty
attributes.enforcement_hint: Derive the version from the exact execution contract and reject a mismatched projection.

attributes.subject: Signal Observer integration
attributes.object: machine admission until a schema, deterministic projector or validator, and no-append fixture exist
attributes.enforcement_hint: Preserve the observer requirement as a conditional gap and never count README or skill prose as machine closure.

attributes.subject: Plan successor
attributes.object: one canonical JSON source as the sole meaning-bearing Plan source
attributes.enforcement_hint: Reject generated views or lifecycle receipts as authored source fields.

attributes.subject: Plan handoff
attributes.object: typed blockers, gates, and one selected execution-entry boundary
attributes.enforcement_hint: Block execution when required readiness evidence is absent or stale.

attributes.responsibility: Turn one admitted Design into one canonical Plan source, deterministic views, and independently admitted Plan bundle without granting execution authority.

attributes.action: Recompile, byte-compare, and run no-effect consumer rehearsals before recording admission.
Compile one normalized graph from the validated source.
Evaluate every row in the consumer applicability matrix, produce each true-branch projection, and record exact negative evidence for each false branch.
Generate only Work Pack, task, wave, layering, and optional Execution Pack navigation from the normalized graph.
Validate the source schema, identities, relationships, graph totals, and predecessor bindings.

attributes.concurrency: Absent outputs only; refuse overwrite or concurrent publication.

planned_witnesses.input_or_violation: Run every applicable machine-backed consumer in no-effect mode and verify negative evidence for every inapplicable consumer.
planned_witnesses.expected_result: All applicable rehearsals pass and no consumer is silently skipped.

planned_witnesses.input_or_violation: Compile the same exact Plan source twice.
planned_witnesses.expected_result: Both runs produce the same ordered files and bytes.

planned_witnesses.input_or_violation: Run Distill with the four exact v1 contracts against the W2 candidate.
planned_witnesses.expected_result: Distill identifies one coherent unit or returns an explicit gap without substituting v2 evidence.

planned_witnesses.input_or_violation: Validate historical v1 Plan material and attempt to use it for a new PASS.
planned_witnesses.expected_result: Historical material validates read-only but cannot establish successor admission.

planned_witnesses.input_or_violation: Project one contract without transient outputs and one with a nonempty transient set.
planned_witnesses.expected_result: The first uses 1.2.0, the second uses 1.3.0, and mismatches are rejected.

planned_witnesses.input_or_violation: Render WORK-PACK.md from the source and inspect objective, slice, wave, task, gate, blocker, gap, and next-action navigation.
planned_witnesses.expected_result: A plan coordinator can find every required item and the view contains no independent authored meaning.

unresolved_gaps.repair_route: Add and admit a Signal Observer schema, deterministic projector or validator, and no-append fixture before claiming observer consumer closure.
unresolved_gaps.effect: Plan bundle admission may proceed only without an observer-closure claim; observability-configured execution remains deferred.

layering.decision: The mandatory authoring vertical is Plan source validation, normalized graph compilation, separate human-view and consumer-contract projection, bundle production, and independent admission. PlanEvidenceResolver and PlanMigrationValidator are conditional boundary adapters outside that stage sequence; readiness and execution remain later external evidence chains.
layering.minimum_unit: One exact Plan source through one normalized graph, separately owned human and consumer projections, byte-identical bundle replay, and no-effect rehearsal or negative evidence for every consumer applicability row.

distill_contract.coherent_unit_candidate: One Plan artifact-authoring vertical from canonical source through independent admission, excluding readiness and execution outcomes.
distill_contract.split_pressure_question: Would splitting the source, normalized graph, views, consumer projections, or admission break deterministic meaning or allow one projection to bypass exact source binding?
